Hi 

I'm running a Spatio-temporal model with this specification:

formula <- O ~ f(ID.area, model='bym2', graph=Rs, constr=TRUE, hyper=list(prec=list(prior=sdunif),phi=list(prior=lunif))) +
        + f(ID.year, model='rw2', constr=TRUE, hyper=list(prec=list(prior=sdunif)))
        + f(ID.area.year, model='generic0', Cmatrix=R, rankdef=r.def, constr=TRUE, hyper=list(prec=list(prior=sdunif)), extraconstr=list(A=A.constr, e=rep(0,nrow(A.constr))))

Generate this error:

GitID: file: error-handler.c  e89a67b045893feb6de6655427031bb828543d00 - Wed Mar 16 16:01:40 2022 +0300
        Error:21 Reason: This should not happen
        Message: Condition `arg->N == N' is not TRUE
        Line:653 Function: GMRFLib_init_hgmrfm

sh: line 1: 17601 Aborted

Can you help me?

Erick
